ukmt-pink-2021-16.title: Count the pairs that must swap
ukmt-pink-2021-16.body:
Write the girls by their initials. Start: F G H I J. Finish: I G F J H.

- For I to finish first she must pass F, G and H: at least 3 overtakes.
- G finishes ahead of F, but G started behind F, so G must overtake F: 1 more.
- J finishes ahead of H, but J started behind H, so J must overtake H: 1 more.

These are five different pairs whose order changes, and each change needs at least one overtake, so at least $5$ points. All other pairs keep their order.

It can be done with exactly 5 overtakes, one at a time: FGHIJ, FGIHJ, FIGHJ, IFGHJ, IGFHJ, IGFJH.

**Answer: (E) 5**

ukmt-pink-2021-18.title: Count how often each $2\times2$ square was chosen
ukmt-pink-2021-18.body:
Let $P,Q,R,S$ be the numbers of times the top-left, top-right, bottom-right and bottom-left $2\times2$ squares were picked. Each corner cell of the grid lies in exactly one of these squares, so the bottom-left corner shows $S=13$ and the cell marked $?$ shows $R$.

The top-middle cell lies in the top-left and top-right squares, so $P+Q=18$. The centre cell lies in all four squares, so $47=P+Q+R+S=18+R+13$, giving $R=16$.

**Answer: (B) 16**
